jesus-is-a-tomorrow-thinker: When your past is over, your accuser will flee. What Jesus told the woman caught in adultery, and how to stop looking back. John 8:11.
do-you-want-to-speak: God takes notice of every word we say. On idle words, the heart as a treasury, and Matthew 12:35.
your-future-has-to-move-into-you: David looked at Goliath from God's point of view. On fear, discouragement and holding on to your dream. 2 Corinthians 4:18.
beyond-offence-there-god-is: Who has hurt you? How Joseph let go of offence, and why a grudge holds your blessing ransom. Matthew 6:14 on forgiveness.
meditation-is-a-visit-with-him: How many times do you lovingly think about Jesus in a day? On putting God first and Matthew 6:33.
the-weapon-of-testimony: The word of our testimony is a weapon. On remembering what God has done, thanksgiving and Revelation 12:11.
gods-time-is-the-best: Tired of waiting? Why beating the gun costs us dearly, and why God's time is the best. Ecclesiastes 3:1 on patience.
warfare-and-salvation: We cannot separate warfare from salvation. On total commitment to Jesus, sitting on the fence, and Joshua 24:15.
one-anothers-strength: We are one another's strength. On your neighbour's weakness, causing others to stumble, and Matthew 18:7.
value-in-challenges: You see that situation that looks impossible? There is value in it. On trials, faith and James 1:2-3.
